title: SIT launches annual Research-to-Impact Collaboration (RIC) workshops
summary: The first RIC workshop brings faculty from across IIT Delhi together to turn promising projects into initiatives, and initiatives into ecosystem-level change.

title: Three PhD graduates in 2026: Rohan Raju Dhanakshirur, Chahat Bansal and Ayushi Agarwal
summary: Congratulations to our 2026 PhD graduates, whose theses span AI in healthcare, satellite-based development monitoring and hardware accelerators.

title: IIT Delhi and Arm workshop: Edge AI and inference on Arm platforms
summary: A three-day hands-on workshop (22-24 August 2025) for college and university teachers in engineering, CS, electronics and AI/ML.

title: Preparatory Research Fellows Programme launched
summary: A funded 6-12 month research fellowship, with no GATE requirement, that prepares capable candidates for admission to SIT's MS (Research) and PhD programmes.

title: PhD viva: Dr Krithika Rangarajan on deep learning in breast-cancer imaging in India
summary: Thesis work on detection networks trained on Indian mammography data, a generative training tool for radiology residents, and a rapid reporting tool evaluated in clinical practice.

title: Landscape Solvability Workshop on CoRE stack data and tools
summary: Over 50 participants from 20 organisations spent three days (5-7 November 2024) designing data, decision logics and learning tools that community stewards can use to plan for their landscapes.

title: Five-day workshop on cybersecurity
summary: A five-day workshop on cybersecurity from 10 June 2024, coordinated by Prof. Kolin Paul and Prof. Vireshwar Kumar.

title: Survey on device fingerprinting for cyber-physical systems published in ACM Computing Surveys
summary: PhD scholar Vijay Kumar and Prof. Kolin Paul's survey is published in ACM Computing Surveys.

title: PhD scholar Subhani receives the Batch of 1969 Innovation Fellow Award
summary: Recognising the CompilerAI Labs effort to turn research on a certified compiler and AI-based deep semantic code analyser into a product prototype, under the guidance of Prof. Sorav Bansal.

title: SIT PhD scholars win PMRF and Google PhD Fellowships
summary: Arnab Mondal, Ayushi Agarwal and Siddharth Shrivastava received the Prime Minister's Research Fellowship, and Anshul Mittal the Google PhD Fellowship.

title: New interdisciplinary M.Tech. in Cybersecurity
summary: SIT hosts a new interdisciplinary M.Tech. programme in Cybersecurity from academic year 2021-22, with CSE, EE, Mathematics and Management Studies.

title: Dr Manik Varma wins the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize
summary: SIT adjunct faculty member and Microsoft Distinguished Scientist Dr Manik Varma receives the Bhatnagar Prize in Engineering Sciences (2019) for contributions to machine learning and computer vision.

title: Suman Muralikrishnan wins FITT Award for best industry-relevant thesis
summary: MS (Research) student Suman Muralikrishnan's thesis is recognised with the FITT Award.
